subject: Ownership Transfer of Demolition Delay Rights
overview: The commission addressed multiple demolition applications, lifting an 18-month delay for 76 Sharon Street following design revisions while seeking a legal opinion on whether delays transfer to new owners at 16 Foster Court. The body also recommended a new member for appointment and reviewed ongoing preservation surveys and masonry projects.

items.title: 80 Canal Street Postponement
items.summary: Postponed the hearing for 80 Canal Street to next month because the owner failed to install required public notification signage.

items.title: 11 Orchard Street Demolition Application
items.summary: Accepted a demolition application for 11 Orchard Street and authorized $500 for a Form B historical survey.

items.title: 75-77 West Street Review Waiver
items.summary: Declined the demolition application for 75-77 West Street and waived further review as the proposed work is primarily interior.

items.title: 76 Sharon Street Delay Lifted
items.summary: Voted to lift the 18-month demolition delay for 76 Sharon Street after the owner successfully revised building plans to rehabilitate the historic roofline and facade.

items.title: 16 Foster Court Legal Procedure
items.summary: Voted to request an expedited legal opinion from city counsel regarding whether a demolition delay persists or restarts when a property under review is sold to a new developer.

items.title: Site Plan Reviews: 595 Broadway and 162 Mystic Avenue
items.summary: Assigned members to draft advisory letters for a development at 595 Broadway and a cannabis dispensary project at 162 Mystic Avenue.

items.title: Commission Appointment Recommendation
items.summary: Voted to recommend applicant Kit Collins for appointment to the commission's vacant seat.

items.title: Public Comment on Residency
items.summary: Eunice Browne questioned the residency requirements for board members and requested clarification on the status of a commissioner who may have relocated outside Medford.

items.title: Status of Properties Under Demolition Delay
items.summary: Discussed ongoing design negotiations for the carriage house at 20 Otis Street and presented detailed historical documentation for 30 Boston Avenue.

items.title: CPA and Survey Project Updates
items.summary: Reviewed progress on the Brooks Estate and Thomas Brooks Park masonry projects, archaeological artifact cataloging, and pending survey bids for Fulton Heights and Winter Hill.

items.title: Approval of Minutes and Adjournment
items.summary: Approved the July meeting minutes and adjourned at 8:22 PM.
